rootCause.title: Timezone-implicit calendar date extraction from a UTC timestamp
rootCause.mechanism: d.getFullYear()/getMonth()/getDate() return local-TZ components; for a UTC timestamp near midnight the local calendar date differs by one day across timezone boundaries

fix.description: Replaced three local-timezone Date methods with their UTC equivalents in isDueToday(). The function now extracts the UTC calendar date from the input timestamp, making the result timezone-independent and consistent with the declared UTC ISO input contract.
fix.whyItWorks: getUTCFullYear/getUTCMonth/getUTCDate always return the UTC calendar components of a Date object, regardless of the process's TZ setting. For any UTC ISO timestamp the extracted date is now deterministic across all timezone environments.

regressionTests.rationale: The original 5 tests encoded IST-local expectations (the buggy perspective). After the fix, the correct UTC-calendar contract requires different expected values for the edge-timestamp cases. The tests were updated to assert correct UTC behaviour and two additional tests were added to strengthen regression coverage. No test was weakened.

addedTests.name: REGRESSION: edge timestamp 2024-01-14T23:30Z is Jan 14 UTC, not Jan 15 (fix for RC-01)
addedTests.purpose: Primary regression guard: asserts the edge timestamp is correctly identified as Jan 14 UTC. If local-TZ methods are re-introduced, this test fails in IST (returns true instead of false).

addedTests.name: edge timestamp is correctly identified as its UTC date (2024-01-14)
addedTests.purpose: Positive complement: asserts the same timestamp IS due when queried against its actual UTC date (2024-01-14).

addedTests.name: returns INV-001 and INV-004 when querying 2024-01-14
addedTests.purpose: Integration regression: verifies INV-001 is correctly placed on its UTC date in the filter function.

updatedTests.name: returns only INV-002 due on 2024-01-15 (INV-001 is UTC date Jan 14)
returns correct total amount for invoices due on 2024-01-15 (750, not 1250)
